events.title: Release date is set!

events.title: Big Demo Update!
events.summary: Hello!Time for a big update.Thanks to all the suggestions received, I’ve improved the game adding new mechanics and new visuals, and so, also updated the Steam page with a new trailer (with new footages of the full version) and screenshots.Here’s the changes of 0.5.12 demo version:- Dash ability- New UI visual- In-place rotation- Controls settings panel- New mouse movement- New enemies attack patterns- Reworked leaderboards/personal score system- Various changes for balancing- Lots of fixes for

events.title: Leaderboards!
events.summary: Hello!I just updated the demo to version 0.2.0, introducing Leaderboards!The leaderboards main score is Research Points, but they also track Time, Kills, and Levels.There will be one for each map, and they are accessible from the "Sample Selection" menu.I've also added a personal High Score system, which will be displayed at the end of each match.Other Changes:Reduced the per-level bonus to the Area stat given by the symbiont Dynamobiont magnitudusReduced emit audio level of symbiont Electrobion

events.title: Micron Survivor Page & Demo OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hi everyone!Today’s a big day: the Steam page for Micron Survivor is officially live, and you can try out the free demo!I’m really excited to finally share this project with you. Any feedback, bug reports, impressions, or suggestions are greatly appreciated, they’ll be incredibly helpful as I continue developing the game.If you like the game, consider adding it to your Wishlist! It would help me a lot.Thank you!Join the discord: https://discord.com/invite/6k3w7KgKfB
